app.title: Red Tape Navigator
app.tagline: Tell us your goal. We research the rules, ask only what is missing, and fill your forms. You review, sign and submit.
app.disclaimer: AI-assisted guidance, not legal advice. Verify with the issuing authority.
app.demoBanner: Demo mode: data stays on this demo server, integrations (DigiLocker, e-Sign, WhatsApp) are simulated, and the forms are placeholders, not official documents.
app.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.heading: Sign in to start
auth.toLogin: Already have an account? Log in
auth.failed: Could not sign in. Check your details.
auth.linkSent: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for 30 minutes.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Please log in.
auth.resetFailed: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

consent.heading: Your data, your choice
consent.intro: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 we need your clear consent. Please read what we do with your data.
consent.service: To research regulations, ask for the details forms need, and fill government forms for you.
consent.reminders: Optional: send renewal and follow-up reminders (email / WhatsApp / SMS).
consent.data: We collect only what the chosen forms require. Aadhaar and PAN are encrypted. We never submit anything for you.
consent.retention: Your session data is deleted automatically after {days} days. You can download or delete it any time.

goal.heading: What do you want to do?
goal.label: Describe your goal in your own words
goal.placeholder: e.g. I want to open a small bakery in Kolkata
goal.demo: Try the demo: bakery in Kolkata
goal.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not available in this browser.

checklist.heading: Your step-by-step plan
checklist.intro: Do these in order. Each item shows where the information comes from.
checklist.form: We can fill this form for you
checklist.noForm: Complete this on the official portal
checklist.conditional: Only needed above the turnover threshold
checklist.verifyHelp: We are not fully sure about this. It has been sent to a human reviewer.
checklist.municipalMissing: We do not have data for your municipality yet. Please check with your local body; a human reviewer has been notified.
checklist.modeKnowledge_base_degraded: Official sites unreachable: showing saved knowledge base
checklist.generalNote: Your business type (“{label}”) is not in our rules pack, so this is the baseline checklist most shops need. Activity-specific licences may also apply; an officer will confirm which.
checklist.outOfScopeHeading: We do not have verified rules for this yet
checklist.outOfScope: An officer has been asked to guide you through it; you do not need to do anything else here. Meanwhile you can search for the scheme or permit on the national portal below, the UMANG app, or your local office.

interview.heading: A few details
interview.intro: We only ask what the forms need, and never twice.
interview.sensitive: Stored encrypted. Never shown in logs.
interview.complete: All set. Let us review your forms.
interview.skippedNote: You skipped {count} question(s). You can answer them later.

review.heading: Review before you sign
review.summary: What this means, in plain language
review.placeholder: This is a placeholder form for demonstration. It is not an official document and must not be submitted.
review.consent: I have reviewed these forms and the information is correct. I understand that I must sign and submit them myself.
review.incomplete: Some required fields are still missing.
review.acknowledge: I will fill the missing fields by hand

done.heading: Ready to sign and submit
done.important: You submit every application yourself on the official portal. This tool never submits anything for you.
done.esignResult: Demo mode: simulated e-Sign. Not legally valid.
done.submittedHelp: Tell us which applications you submitted and we will remind you to check status and renew.

privacy.heading: Your data
privacy.confirm: This permanently deletes your data. Continue?

staff.title: Officer console
staff.denied: This page is for authorised staff only. Please log in with a staff account.
staff.error: Could not load the console. Please try again.
